name: 연
outfit: 짙은 청록색과 금색 자수가 놓인 한복풍 의복
silhouette: 아홉 개의 꼬리 뒤로 불꽃이 흩날리는 형태, 큼직한 여우 귀
signature_vfx: 아홉 개의 밝은 주황색 불꽃이 캐릭터 주변을 회전하며 적을 타격함
unique_features: 아홉 개의 꼬리 수만큼 떠다니는 여우불
visual_en: A small 2-head tall chibi fox-demon facing right. The character has deep navy hair and sharp bright gold eyes. They wear a rich teal green traditional hanbok with intricate gold embroidery and crimson red shoes. Behind them, nine large, voluminous tails fan out, each accompanied by a floating, vivid orange fox-fire orb. Tiny magical golden particles drift around the body. The silhouette is distinct with large fox ears and the swirling pattern of nine tails and orbiting flames.
features_en: Nine fox-fire orbs corresponding to each tail
Floating magical elements around the body
pose_en: Standing regally while commanding floating flames with a confident gaze.
vfx_en: Nine bright orange and golden flame orbs orbiting the character rapidly.
lore: 구미호 반요 — 꼬리 수만큼 여우불을 띄운다. 무기 여우불.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.

frame_notes.entrance_2: Small orange fox-fire orbs float around it in a ring, the whole body clearly visible

anchor_edits: Remove the glowing halo ring floating above the head completely. Keep everything else exactly the same: face, hair, horns, ears, outfit, colors, weapon, pose and size.

body_plan.body: A humanoid fox character with blue hair, wearing a green and red robe, featuring multiple large orange tails.
